reason: My problem isn't finding or paying creators, I already DM them and Venmo them for nothing. My problem is I don't have time to manage them and approve drafts, and this still puts me in the middle of every draft and every live post.
objection: It's another dashboard to babysit plus a 5% fee on something I already do for free, and the follower counts and results aren't even verified, so I'd still be checking profiles myself.
would_change_my_mind: If it took the managing off my plate, like a creator who's done great work for brands like mine handling it end to end where I only glance at the final post, or verified results so I could trust a creator without vetting them myself.
